Hi Micah —

Thanks for signing up for a trial with Redwood. I booked 30 minutes of office hours so we can get your API key provisioned and walk through our Node and Python SDKs. Proposed slot is Tue, Dec 2 at 3:00 PM PT (30 min).

Agenda (quick):
- Provision API key + scope
- Create API call from your dev machine (Node/Python examples)
- Check integration: 100-token test and error handling

If that time doesn't work, tell me two times that do and I’ll update the invite. I've attached a short checklist to speed things up.

[attachment: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Micah Taylor <micah@greenatlas.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Missed our office hours — quick unblock options + next slots

Micah —

We were on for 3:00 PM PT today but didn't see you join the call. No worries — these sessions get missed. Two quick ways to get unblocked right now:

1) Self-serve (fastest) — if you have a minute, create a new API key from the dashboard and paste it into this minimal Node snippet: 

[attachment: sample-sdk-snippet.txt (TXT, 1KB)]
```
const Redwood = require('@redwoodai/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(resp.output);
```

2) If you'd like us on the call, here are my next 3 open 30-minute slots: Wed Dec 3 — 10:00 AM PT, 2:00 PM PT; Thu Dec 4 — 11:30 AM PT. Pick one and I'll send a fresh invite.

I included the onboarding checklist and a short troubleshooting checklist below in case the key scope or network egress is the blocker. If you'd like Marissa to join for a quick config on Dedicated capacity / VPC egress, she can hop on.

Troubleshooting quick checks:
- Confirm API key listed in dashboard and not expired
- If behind corporate proxy, allow outgoing to api.redwood.ai:443
- Check 401 vs 403 responses (401 = missing/invalid key)

If you prefer a hands-on session, tell me which slot works and I’ll lock it in.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
